basic_info.description: This delightful home in Visitacion Valley has plenty to offer.  A large living room, eat in kitchen, three bedrooms and an original bathroom on the main level. Bonus room and a full size garage, parking on the driveway possible, washer/dryer and a 115' deep lot makes the sunny yard a great space to use for family or relaxing. You are next to Lelands commercial strip with restaurants, stores and bank. Only a few blocks away is the majesty of McLaren Park (SF's second largest park) spanning 312 acres encompassing scenic meadows and natural habitats, over 7 miles of walking trails, playgrounds, picnic areas, game courts, the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater, a 9-hole golf course, a lake, and the newly renovated Coffman Pool. This tenant occupied property is a great investment opportunity.
